examinations.name: Joint-line palpation

examinations.method: Patient supine; palpate medial and lateral joint lines during slow knee flexion/extension; record the exact tender site and distinguish adjacent bursal tenderness.
precautions: Clinician-performed only; this review artifact is not a complete protocol for acute painful or unstable injury.
limitations: Tenderness is nonspecific; no sensitivity or specificity is extracted.

limitations: Positive denotes a documented abnormality, not a disease diagnosis; no diagnostic-accuracy estimate.
